description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Accenture is hiring a Custom Software Engineer to design, code, enhance, troubleshoot, and support custom software components. The role works with cross-functional teams to align development with business objectives and improve coding standards and processes.
Custom Software Engineer designing, coding, and troubleshooting custom software components across systems and applications

Responsibilities:
• Design, code, and enhance custom software components across systems and applications using modern frameworks and agile practices
• Work independently and grow into a subject matter expert, taking an active part in team discussions and offering solutions to work-related problems
• Apply analytical thinking to troubleshoot and resolve complex software issues efficiently
• Work with cross-functional teams to align software development with business objectives
• Continuously improve coding standards and development processes, and share knowledge to support team growth
• Adapt to evolving project requirements by embracing agile methodologies and innovative solutions

Requirements:
• Minimum 1 year of hands-on software development experience using C (Programming Language)
• Minimum 1 year of experience designing, coding, and enhancing software components, preferably in an agile environment
• Minimum 1 year of experience troubleshooting and resolving software issues
• HS Diploma / GED

Preferred:
• Proficiency in Python software development
• Experience with custom application development
• Experience with Unix shell scripting
• Experience working with cross-functional teams to align technical solutions with business objectives
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
